question: What does the selected AC1024 LayerStates XRECORD group 370=-3 prove, and what independent evidence is needed for DXF/native semantics?

sourceObservation.provenance: Existing local corpus; original author and producing release not independently authenticated. No drawing fixture or derivative was committed.
sourceObservation.sourceGraph: LAYER_CONTROL extension -> ACAD_LAYERSTATES -> ACAD_VIEWS_RenderView -> XRECORD 0x249; XRECORD xdict -> 0x24A -> XRECORD 0x24B -> SCALE 0x127. Source handles are witness identities only, not fixed format semantics.
sourceObservation.primaryBody: 0x249 has 77 data bytes and 11 ordered values: 91=33280, 301="", 290=0, 302="0", 330=0x10, 90=8, 62=7, 370=-3, 331=0x16, 1="Color_7", 92=-1024986881. The signed 16-bit wire representation of 370 is 0xFFFD.

specifications.authority: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, local authoritative copy
specifications.finding: The XRECORD source data block is a bounded sequence of RS group indicators followed by corresponding values; common handles follow in the handle stream. This specifies wire carriers and ordering, not application-specific LayerStates meaning or AutoCAD DXF acceptance of group 370.
The documented application data range is 1–369, excluding 5 and 105; group 370 lies outside this XRECORD-specific range.
The XRECORD group-code table ends at 360–369. Codes 330–339 are soft-pointer IDs and 360–369 are hard-owner IDs; these documented ranges do not define group 370 as XRECORD application data.

The general enumeration includes ByLineWeightDefault=-3. This does not establish that 370=-3 inside this proprietary LayerStates XRECORD is a lineweight field or that a named-view snapshot restores it.

A named view can save a layer snapshot; the documented view workflow restores on/off and thaw/freeze visibility, not locked state. It does not establish lineweight restoration by a named-view snapshot.
The API provides state enumeration, mask/layer queries, comparison, saving and restoring. Use it to measure behavior separately from byte-level readback.

peerStatus.observation: Independent pinned source trace and JSON report 370=-3 for the selected XRECORD; a prior independent LibreDWG DXF export also emitted that value. This corroborates a source/producer transport observation only.
peerStatus.reread: A subsequent LibreDWG JSON reread returned ERROR 0x800; no independent reread success or native AutoCAD acceptance is claimed.
peerStatus.local: Prior selected/projection ASCII/Binary libdxfrw write/readback was transport evidence only; the old three-root selector no longer passes current source guard. Current source-wire and graph predicates remain disconnected from output admission.

hostPrerequisites: A user-provided AutoCAD/ObjectARX-capable host, with release/year, exact operating system, selected DWG/DXF format version and locale recorded. A remote host additionally needs an authorized file-transfer/command channel; no credentials or secrets belong in this receipt.

A clean scratch workspace and a way to run a small ObjectARX or equivalent supported AutoCAD probe that enumerates named layer states and XRECORD result buffers. Pin host build and probe source/binary hashes.
pairedProducerProtocol: On the host, create a drawing locally from scratch with at least two layers and controlled on/off, frozen/thawed, color, linetype and lineweight differences. Save a named view using Save Layer Snapshot with View. Record all explicit operations and resulting layer/view identifiers.

Save a native AC1024 DWG and an AutoCAD-produced 2010 DXF from the same recorded drawing state. Confirm actual headers/version; hash the files and host logs. Inspect the actual emitted dictionary key and group sequence rather than assuming the ACAD_VIEWS_ prefix or group-370 behavior.

Open the native DWG and DXF independently in AutoCAD, enumerate state names/masks and layer values, record any import warnings, and use documented view restoration to compare the visibility state before and after. Save/reopen and repeat. Preserve exact failures as negative evidence.

As a separate profile, save ordinary named layer states with lineweight default and a distinct explicit weight; perturb the setting, restore with a mask that includes lineweight, and measure actual results. Do not infer named-view snapshot lineweight semantics from this separate experiment.

When an output candidate is available, open both its ASCII and Binary DXF on the host, save/reopen and repeat the same checks. Independently compare ordered XRECORD group types, values, translated owner/reactor/xdict and LAYER/LTYPE/SCALE references with a native pair. Record unsupported group-370 handling or failed imports instead of normalizing them away.
nativeWitness.target: Producer-created named-view layer snapshot and any separately created ordinary state that actually contains the selected XRECORD group profile, with AC1024 format and native behavior captured. A different key, code set, or version is a separate profile.
nativeWitness.promotionGate: Require an exact producer/source profile, independently verified native output acceptance plus semantic before/after behavior for properties actually asserted. Do not generalize one witness, a libdxfrw roundtrip, or a LibreDWG export into a broad XRECORD or LayerStates claim.

safeStagedControls.existingSeam: dxfRW::setDxfObjectsWriteInspector with DxfObjectsWriteView and the existing direct writer/sentinel patterns in tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp.
safeStagedControls.method: Use the original importing adapter and data for real source-proof checks. For record-level staged inspection, copy the staged view bytes into a test-owned buffer, alter one selected group/role/target or remove it, and feed that view to the inspector; return false on rejection so the writer retains a seeded destination. Restore the source/view and retry through the same writer for ASCII and Binary.
safeStagedControls.scope: This proves inspector decisions and transactional refusal for the tested staged view only. A synthetic view or force-enabled low-level writer is not production graph admission, independent readback, native LayerStates behavior, or whole-file completeness.

dxfOut.finding: Autodesk documents AcDbDatabase::dxfOut with the 2010 version constant AcDb::kDHL_1024; precision 16 selects ASCII and precision -1 selects Binary DXF. Check the actual installed SDK release, enum spelling, host API availability and returned Acad::ErrorStatus before executing; the remote release is not yet known.

xrecordRead.finding: Autodesk documents AcDbXrecord::rbChain for reading a result-buffer list. Record its actual status and every returned code/value/translated object ID; a rejection, omitted value or inability to decode 370 is evidence, not a successful read.

saveAs.finding: Documented SAVEAS supports DWG and versioned ASCII/Binary DXF. Exact prompts and available historical formats must be verified for the provided host release.

hostApiFeasibility.limits: The documented workflow is feasible in principle, not yet verified on the user-provided remote host. No host details, access channel, credentials or command execution were requested or attempted.
